bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 起昭陽太淵獻，盡玄黓涒灘，凡十年。

translations.literal: From Zhaoyang Taiyuanxian through Xuanqi Tunshan; ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhaoyang Taiyuanxian through Xuanqi Tunshan—ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 1春，二月，以鳳皇、甘露降集京師，赦天下。

translations.literal: 1. In spring, the second month, because phoenixes and sweet dew descended and gathered at the capital, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In spring, the second month, because phoenixes and sweet dew descended upon the capital, the empire was pardoned.

sentences.zh: ----2穎川太守黃霸在郡前後八年，政事愈治；

translations.literal: ----2 Huang Ba, governor of Yingchuan, had been in the commandery eight years in all; administration grew ever better governed;
translations.idiomatic: ----2 Huang Ba, governor of Yingchuan, had governed the commandery eight years in all; administration grew ever sounder;

sentences.zh: 是時鳳皇、神爵數集郡國，穎川尤多。

translations.literal: at that time phoenixes and divine finches repeatedly gathered in commanderies and kingdoms, and Yingchuan had especially many.
translations.idiomatic: at that time phoenixes and divine finches repeatedly gathered across the realm, and Yingchuan had especially many.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，詔曰：「穎川太守霸，宣佈詔令，百姓嚮化，孝子、弟弟、貞婦、順孫日以眾多，田者讓畔，道不拾遺，養視鰥寡，贍助貧窮，獄或八年亡重罪囚，其賜爵關內侯、黃金百斤、秩中二千石。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, an edict said: "Huang Ba, governor of Yingchuan, has proclaimed and spread imperial edicts; the people have turned toward transformation. Filial sons, respectful younger brothers, chaste wives, and obedient grandsons grow more numerous day by day; plowmen yield field boundaries, none pick up lost things on the road, orphans and widows are cared for, the poor are supported and aided, and in the prisons for eight years there have been no prisoners of serious crimes. He is granted the rank of Marquis within the Passes, a hundred jin of gold, and salary of zhong erqian shi."
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, an edict said: "Huang Ba, governor of Yingchuan, has proclaimed and spread imperial edicts; the people have turned toward virtue. Filial sons, respectful younger brothers, chaste wives, and obedient grandsons grow more numerous day by day; plowmen yield field boundaries, none pick up lost things on the road, orphans and widows are cared for, the poor are supported, and in the prisons for eight years there have been no prisoners of serious crimes. Grant him the rank of Marquis within the Passes, a hundred jin of gold, and salary of zhong erqian shi."

sentences.zh: 」而穎川孝、弟、有行義民、三老、力田皆以差賜爵及帛。

translations.literal: " Moreover, filial sons, younger brothers, men of righteous conduct, village elders, and champion farmers of Yingchuan were all granted ranks and silks by gradation.
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover, filial sons, younger brothers, men of righteous conduct, village elders, and champion farmers of Yingchuan were all granted ranks and silks by gradation.

sentences.zh: 後數月，征霸為太子太傅。

translations.literal: Several months later, Ba was summoned to be Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later, Ba was summoned to serve as Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: ----3五月，匈奴單于遣弟呼留若王勝之來朝。

translations.literal: ----3 In the fifth month, the Xiongnu chanyu sent his younger brother Huluruo Wang Shengzhi to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In the fifth month, the Xiongnu chanyu sent his younger brother Huluruo Wang Shengzhi to attend court.

sentences.zh: ----4冬，十月，鳳皇十一集杜陵。

translations.literal: ----4 In winter, the tenth month, eleven phoenixes gathered at Duling.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In winter, the tenth month, eleven phoenixes gathered at Duling.

sentences.zh: ----5河南太守東海嚴延年為治陰鷙酷烈，眾人所謂當死者一朝出之，所謂當生者詭殺之，吏民莫能測其意深淺，戰慄不敢犯禁。

translations.literal: ----5 Yan Yannian of Donghai, governor of Henan, governed with hidden severity and fierce cruelty: those the multitude said should die he released in a morning; those they said should live he killed by trickery. Officials and people alike could not gauge the depth or shallowness of his intent; trembling, they dared not violate his prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 Yan Yannian of Donghai, governor of Henan, governed with hidden severity and fierce cruelty: those the multitude said should die he released in a morning; those they said should live he killed by trickery. Officials and people alike could not gauge his intent; trembling, they dared not violate his prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 冬月，傳屬縣囚會論府上，流血數里，河南號曰「屠伯」。

translations.literal: In the winter months he summoned county prisoners to be tried together at the prefectural seat; blood flowed for several li. Henan called him the "Butcher Lord."
translations.idiomatic: In winter he summoned county prisoners to be tried together at the prefectural seat; blood flowed for several li. Henan called him the "Butcher Lord."

sentences.zh: 延年素輕黃霸為人，及比郡為守，褒賞反在己前，心內不服。

translations.literal: Yannian had long looked down on Huang Ba as a man; when a neighboring commandery had him as governor, praise and rewards came before his own, and inwardly he would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian had long looked down on Huang Ba; when a neighboring commandery had him as governor, praise and rewards came before his own, and inwardly he would not submit.

sentences.zh: 河南界中又有蝗蟲，府丞義出行蝗，還，見延年。

translations.literal: Within Henan's borders there were also locusts; Assistant Prefect Yi went out to drive off locusts, returned, and saw Yannian.
translations.idiomatic: Within Henan's borders locusts appeared; Assistant Prefect Yi went out to drive them off, returned, and saw Yannian.

sentences.zh: 延年曰：「此蝗豈鳳皇食邪？

translations.literal: Yannian said: "Are these locusts perhaps food for phoenixes?
translations.idiomatic: Yannian said: "Are these locusts perhaps food for phoenixes?

sentences.zh: 」義年老，頗悖，素畏延年，恐見中傷。

translations.literal: " Yi was old and rather contrary; he had long feared Yannian and dreaded being struck at and harmed.
translations.idiomatic: " Yi was old and rather contrary; he had long feared Yannian and dreaded being struck at and harmed.

sentences.zh: 延年本嘗與義俱為丞相史，實親厚之，饋遺之甚厚。

translations.literal: Yannian had once served together with Yi as clerks to the chancellor and had truly been close and thick with him, sending him very generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian had once served with Yi as clerks to the chancellor and had truly been close to him, sending him very generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 義愈益恐，自筮，得死卦，忽忽不樂，取告至長安，上書言延年罪名十事；

translations.literal: Yi grew ever more fearful, divined for himself, and obtained the death hexagram; restless and unhappy, he took leave to Chang'an and submitted a memorial listing ten charges against Yannian;
translations.idiomatic: Yi grew ever more fearful, divined for himself, and obtained the death hexagram; restless and unhappy, he took leave to Chang'an and submitted a memorial listing ten charges against Yannian;

sentences.zh: 已拜奏，因飲藥自殺，以明不欺。

translations.literal: after the memorial had been presented he drank poison and killed himself, to show he did not deceive.
translations.idiomatic: after the memorial had been presented he drank poison and killed himself, to show he did not deceive.

sentences.zh: 事下御史丞按驗，得其語言怨望、誹謗政治數事。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the Vice Censor-in-Chief for investigation and verification; they obtained several matters of his words showing resentment and slandering the government.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent down to the Vice Censor-in-Chief for investigation; they obtained several matters of his words showing resentment and slandering the government.

sentences.zh: 十一月，延年坐不道，棄市。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Yannian was convicted of impiety and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yannian was convicted of impiety and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 初，延年母從東海來，欲從延年臘。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yannian's mother came from Donghai, wishing to keep the year-end sacrifice with Yannian.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yannian's mother came from Donghai, wishing to keep the year-end sacrifice with Yannian.

sentences.zh: 到洛陽，適見報囚，母大驚，便止都亭，不肯入府。

translations.literal: Reaching Luoyang, she happened to see the report of prisoners; the mother was greatly alarmed, stopped at the capital post station, and would not enter the prefectural offices.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Luoyang, she happened to see the report of prisoners; the mother was greatly alarmed, stopped at the capital post station, and would not enter the prefectural offices.

sentences.zh: 延年出至都亭謁母，母閉閣不見。

translations.literal: Yannian went out to the post station to pay respects to his mother; the mother shut the door and would not see him.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian went out to the post station to pay respects to his mother; the mother shut the door and would not see him.

sentences.zh: 延年免冠頓首閣下，良久，母乃見之，因數責延年：「幸得備郡守，專治千里，不聞仁愛教化，有以全安愚民。

translations.literal: Yannian removed his cap and knocked his head at the door for a long time before the mother at last saw him, and thereupon repeatedly reproached Yannian: "You were fortunate enough to serve as commandery governor, with sole charge of a thousand li, yet I hear nothing of benevolent love and transforming instruction by which to preserve and secure foolish commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian removed his cap and knocked his head at the door for a long time before the mother at last saw him, and thereupon repeatedly reproached Yannian: "You were fortunate enough to serve as commandery governor, with sole charge of a thousand li, yet I hear nothing of benevolent love and transforming instruction by which to preserve and secure foolish commoners.

sentences.zh: 顧乘刑罰，多刑殺人，欲以立威，豈為民父母意哉！

translations.literal: Instead you rely on punishments, putting many to death by punishment, wishing thereby to establish awe—how is this the intent of parents to the people!
translations.idiomatic: Instead you rely on punishments, putting many to death, wishing thereby to establish awe—how is this the intent of parents to the people!

sentences.zh: 」延年服罪，重頓首謝，因自為母御歸府舍。

translations.literal: " Yannian acknowledged guilt, knocked his head again in thanks, and thereupon himself drove the carriage for his mother back to the official residence.
translations.idiomatic: " Yannian acknowledged guilt, knocked his head again in thanks, and thereupon himself drove the carriage for his mother back to the official residence.

sentences.zh: 母畢正臘，謂延年曰：「天道神明，人不可獨殺。

translations.literal: When the mother had finished the proper year-end sacrifice, she said to Yannian: "Heaven's Way is divine and bright; a man must not kill alone.
translations.idiomatic: When the mother had finished the proper year-end sacrifice, she said to Yannian: "Heaven's Way is divine and bright; a man must not kill alone.

sentences.zh: 我不意當老見壯子被刑戮也！

translations.literal: I never thought I would grow old only to see my strong son subjected to punishment and execution!
translations.idiomatic: I never thought I would grow old only to see my strong son subjected to punishment and execution!

sentences.zh: 行矣，去汝東歸，掃除墓地耳！

translations.literal: Go! Leave you and return east—I have only to sweep the graveyard!
translations.idiomatic: Go! Leave you and return east—I have only to sweep the graveyard!

sentences.zh: 」遂去，歸郡，見昆弟、宗人，復為言之。

translations.literal: " She thereupon left, returned to the commandery, saw brothers and clansmen, and spoke of it again.
translations.idiomatic: " She thereupon left, returned to the commandery, saw brothers and clansmen, and spoke of it again.

sentences.zh: 後歲餘，果敗，東海莫不賢智其母。

translations.literal: More than a year later he indeed fell; in Donghai none failed to regard his mother as worthy and wise.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he indeed fell; in Donghai none failed to regard his mother as worthy and wise.

sentences.zh: ----6匈奴握衍朐鞮單于暴虐，好殺伐，國中不附。

translations.literal: ----6 The Xiongnu chanyu Woyu Jodi was violent and cruel, fond of killing and campaigning; within the state none adhered to him.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 The Xiongnu chanyu Woyu Jodi was violent and cruel, fond of killing and campaigning; within the state none adhered to him.

sentences.zh: 及太子、左賢王數讒左地貴人，左地貴人皆怨。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent and the Left Worthy King repeatedly slandered the nobles of the left territory; the nobles of the left territory all bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent and the Left Worthy King repeatedly slandered the nobles of the left territory; the nobles of the left territory all bore resentment.

sentences.zh: 會烏桓擊匈奴東邊姑夕王，頗得人民，單于怒。

translations.literal: It happened that the Wuhuan struck the Xiongnu eastern-side Guxi King and took quite a number of people; the chanyu was enraged.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Wuhuan struck the Xiongnu eastern-side Guxi King and took quite a number of people; the chanyu was enraged.

sentences.zh: 姑夕王恐，即與烏禪幕及左地貴人共立稽侯狦為呼韓邪單于，發左地兵四五萬人，西擊握衍朐鞮單于，至姑且水北。

translations.literal: The Guxi King was afraid and at once joined Wuchanmu and the nobles of the left territory in installing Ji Houyu as Chanyu Huhanye, raising forty or fifty thousand troops of the left territory and striking west against Chanyu Woyu Jodi, reaching north of the Guxi River.
translations.idiomatic: The Guxi King was afraid and at once joined Wuchanmu and the nobles of the left territory in installing Ji Houyu as Chanyu Huhanye, raising forty or fifty thousand troops of the left territory and striking west against Chanyu Woyu Jodi, reaching north of the Guxi River.

sentences.zh: 未戰，握衍朐鞮單于兵敗走，使人報其弟右賢王曰：「匈奴共攻我，若肯發兵助我乎？

translations.literal: Before battle was joined, Chanyu Woyu Jodi's army was defeated and fled; he sent a man to report to his younger brother the Right Worthy King, saying: "The Xiongnu are all attacking me—will you be willing to raise troops and aid me?
translations.idiomatic: Before battle was joined, Chanyu Woyu Jodi's army was defeated and fled; he sent a man to report to his younger brother the Right Worthy King, saying: "The Xiongnu are all attacking me—will you be willing to raise troops and aid me?

sentences.zh: 」右賢王曰：「若不愛人，殺昆弟、諸貴人。

translations.literal: " The Right Worthy King said: "You do not love men—you have killed brothers and the various nobles.
translations.idiomatic: " The Right Worthy King said: "You do not love men—you have killed brothers and the various nobles.

sentences.zh: 各自死若處，無來污我！

translations.literal: Each die in your own place—do not come to defile me!
translations.idiomatic: Each die in your own place—do not come to defile me!

sentences.zh: 」握衍朐鞮單于恚，自殺。

translations.literal: " Chanyu Woyu Jodi, enraged, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: " Chanyu Woyu Jodi, enraged, killed himself.

sentences.zh: 左大且渠都隆奇亡之右賢王所，其民眾盡降呼韓邪單于。

translations.literal: The Left Grand Commandant Dulongqi fled to the Right Worthy King's place; his people all surrendered to Chanyu Huhanye.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Grand Commandant Dulongqi fled to the Right Worthy King's place; his people all surrendered to Chanyu Huhanye.

sentences.zh: 呼韓邪單于歸庭；

translations.literal: Chanyu Huhanye returned to the court;
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Huhanye returned to the court;

sentences.zh: 數月，罷兵，使各歸故地，乃收其兄呼屠吾斯在民間者，立為左谷蠡王，使人告右賢貴人，欲令殺右賢王，其冬，都隆奇與右賢王共立日逐王薄胥堂為屠耆單于，發兵數萬人東襲呼韓邪單于，呼韓邪單于兵敗走。

translations.literal: several months later he dismissed the armies and sent each back to his former territory; he then gathered his elder brother Hutuwusi, who was among the people, and installed him as Left Guli King, and sent a man to tell the Right Worthy nobles, wishing to have the Right Worthy King killed. That winter, Dulongqi and the Right Worthy King jointly installed the Rizhu King Boxutang as Chanyu Tujue, raised an army of several tens of thousands, and struck east against Chanyu Huhanye; Chanyu Huhanye's army was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: several months later he dismissed the armies and sent each back to his former territory; he then gathered his elder brother Hutuwusi, who was among the people, and installed him as Left Guli King, and sent a man to tell the Right Worthy nobles, wishing to have the Right Worthy King killed. That winter, Dulongqi and the Right Worthy King jointly installed the Rizhu King Boxutang as Chanyu Tujue, raised an army of several tens of thousands, and struck east against Chanyu Huhanye; Chanyu Huhanye's army was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于還，以其長子都塗吾西為左谷蠡王，少子姑瞀樓頭為右谷蠡王，留居單于庭。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue returned, made his eldest son Dutuwuxi Left Guli King and his younger son Gumoloutou Right Guli King, and remained dwelling at the chanyu court.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue returned, made his eldest son Dutuwuxi Left Guli King and his younger son Gumoloutou Right Guli King, and remained dwelling at the chanyu court.

sentences.zh: 1春，正月，上幸甘泉，郊泰畤。

translations.literal: 1. In spring, the first month, the emperor favored Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the border to the Great Altar.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In spring, the first month, the emperor traveled to Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the Great Altar.

sentences.zh: ----2皇太子冠。

translations.literal: ----2 The Imperial Heir Apparent received the capping.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 The Imperial Heir Apparent received the capping.

sentences.zh: ----3秋，匈奴屠耆單于使先賢撣兄右奧鞬王與烏藉都尉各二萬騎屯東方，以備呼韓邪單于。

translations.literal: ----3 In autumn, the Xiongnu chanyu Tujue sent the Right Aojian King, elder brother of the Xianxian chanyu, and the Wujie Commandant, each with twenty thousand horse, to garrison in the east against Chanyu Huhanye.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In autumn, the Xiongnu chanyu Tujue sent the Right Aojian King, elder brother of the Xianxian chanyu, and the Wujie Commandant, each with twenty thousand horse, to garrison in the east against Chanyu Huhanye.

sentences.zh: 是時西方呼揭王來與唯犁當戶謀，共讒右賢王。

translations.literal: At that time the Western Hujie King came and plotted with Weili Danghu, jointly slandering the Right Worthy King,
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Western Hujie King came and plotted with Weili Danghu, jointly slandering the Right Worthy King,

sentences.zh: 言欲自立為單于。

translations.literal: saying he wished to install himself as chanyu.
translations.idiomatic: saying he wished to install himself as chanyu.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于殺右賢王父子，後知其冤，復殺唯犁當戶。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue killed the Right Worthy King and his son; later learning it was unjust, he killed Weili Danghu as well.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue killed the Right Worthy King and his son; later learning it was unjust, he killed Weili Danghu as well.

sentences.zh: 於是呼揭王恐，遂畔去，自立為呼揭單于。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Hujie King was afraid, turned rebel and left, and installed himself as Chanyu Hujie.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Hujie King was afraid, rebelled and left, and installed himself as Chanyu Hujie.

sentences.zh: 右奧鞬王聞之，即自立為車犁單于。

translations.literal: The Right Aojian King heard of it and at once installed himself as Chanyu Chelí.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Aojian King heard of it and at once installed himself as Chanyu Chelí.

sentences.zh: 烏藉都尉亦自立為烏藉單于。

translations.literal: The Wujie Commandant also installed himself as Chanyu Wujie.
translations.idiomatic: The Wujie Commandant also installed himself as Chanyu Wujie.

sentences.zh: 凡五單于。

translations.literal: In all there were five chanyus.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were five chanyus.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于自將兵東擊車犁單于，使都隆奇擊烏藉。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue himself led troops east to strike Chanyu Chelí and sent Dulongqi to strike Wujie.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue himself led troops east to strike Chanyu Chelí and sent Dulongqi to strike Wujie.

sentences.zh: 烏藉、車犁皆敗，西北走，與呼揭單于兵合為四萬人。

translations.literal: Wujie and Chelí were both defeated and fled northwest; their troops joined with Chanyu Hujie's forces to make forty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Wujie and Chelí were both defeated and fled northwest; their troops joined with Chanyu Hujie's forces to make forty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 烏藉、呼揭皆去單于號，共並力尊輔車犁單于。

translations.literal: Wujie and Hujie both cast off the title of chanyu and jointly with united strength honored and supported Chanyu Chelí.
translations.idiomatic: Wujie and Hujie both cast off the title of chanyu and jointly honored and supported Chanyu Chelí.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于聞之，使左大將、都尉將四萬騎分屯東方，以備呼韓邪單于，自將四萬騎西擊車犁單于。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue heard of it and sent the Left Grand General and Commandant with forty thousand horse to garrison separately in the east against Chanyu Huhanye; he himself led forty thousand horse west to strike Chanyu Chelí.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue heard of it and sent the Left Grand General and Commandant with forty thousand horse to garrison separately in the east against Chanyu Huhanye; he himself led forty thousand horse west to strike Chanyu Chelí.

sentences.zh: 車犁單于敗，西北走。

translations.literal: Chanyu Chelí was defeated and fled northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Chelí was defeated and fled northwest.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于即引兵西南留闟敦地。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue thereupon led his troops southwest and halted at Tadun.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue thereupon led his troops southwest and halted at Tadun.

sentences.zh: 漢議者多曰：「匈奴為害日久，可因其壞亂，舉兵滅之。

translations.literal: Many among the Han deliberators said: "The Xiongnu have been a harm for long; we may take advantage of their breakdown and disorder and raise troops to destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: Many among the Han deliberators said: "The Xiongnu have been a harm for long; we may take advantage of their breakdown and disorder and raise troops to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 」詔問御史大夫蕭望之，對曰：「《春秋》，晉士匄帥師侵齊，聞齊侯卒，引師而還，君子大其不伐喪，以為恩足以服孝子，誼足以動諸侯。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered inquiry of Censor-in-Chief Xiao Wangzhi, who answered: "In the Spring and Autumn Annals, Shi Gai of Jin led troops to invade Qi; hearing that the Marquis of Qi had died, he led his army back. The noble man greatly praised his not attacking during mourning, holding that grace suffices to win filial sons and righteousness suffices to move the feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered inquiry of Censor-in-Chief Xiao Wangzhi, who answered: "In the Spring and Autumn Annals, Shi Gai of Jin led troops to invade Qi; hearing that the Marquis of Qi had died, he led his army back. The noble man greatly praised his not attacking during mourning, holding that grace suffices to win filial sons and righteousness suffices to move the feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 前單于慕化嚮善，稱弟，遣使請求和親，海內欣然，夷狄莫不聞。

translations.literal: The former chanyu admired transformation and turned toward goodness, called himself younger brother, and sent envoys requesting peace through marriage; within the seas all rejoiced, and none among the barbarians failed to hear.
translations.idiomatic: The former chanyu admired transformation and turned toward goodness, called himself younger brother, and sent envoys requesting peace through marriage; within the seas all rejoiced, and none among the barbarians failed to hear.

sentences.zh: 未終奉約，不幸為賊臣所殺；

translations.literal: Before he had finished fulfilling the covenant, he was unfortunately killed by treacherous ministers;
translations.idiomatic: Before he had finished fulfilling the covenant, he was unfortunately killed by treacherous ministers;

sentences.zh: 今而伐之，是乘亂而幸災也，彼必奔走遠遁。

translations.literal: to attack them now is to ride disorder and rejoice in disaster; they will surely flee in flight to distant places.
translations.idiomatic: to attack them now is to ride disorder and rejoice in disaster; they will surely flee to distant places.

sentences.zh: 不以義動兵，恐勞而無功。

translations.literal: To move troops without righteousness—I fear toil without achievement.
translations.idiomatic: To move troops without righteousness—I fear toil without achievement.

sentences.zh: 宜遣使者弔問，輔其微弱，救其災患。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dispatch envoys to offer condolences and inquiry, assist their weakness, and relieve their disasters and afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to dispatch envoys to offer condolences, assist their weakness, and relieve their disasters.

sentences.zh: 四夷聞之，咸貴中國之仁義。

translations.literal: When the four barbarians hear of it, all will esteem the Middle Kingdom's benevolence and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: When the four barbarians hear of it, all will esteem the Middle Kingdom's benevolence and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 如遂蒙恩得復其位，必稱臣服從，此德之盛之。

translations.literal: If he then receives grace and regains his position, he will surely declare submission and obedience—this is the fullness of virtue."
translations.idiomatic: If he then receives grace and regains his position, he will surely declare submission and obedience—this is the fullness of virtue."

sentences.zh: 」上從其議。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed his counsel.

sentences.zh: ----4冬，十有二月，乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: ----4 In winter, the twelfth month, on the first day of the month yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In winter, the twelfth month, on the first day of the month yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: ----5韓延壽代蕭望之為左馮翊。

translations.literal: ----5 Han Yannian replaced Xiao Wangzhi as Left Governor of Feng.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 Han Yannian replaced Xiao Wangzhi as Left Governor of Feng.

sentences.zh: 望之聞延壽在東郡時放散官錢千餘萬，使御史案之。

translations.literal: Wangzhi heard that while Yannian was in Dong commandery he had dispersed more than ten million in official funds and had the censor investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Wangzhi heard that while Yannian was in Dong commandery he had dispersed more than ten million in official funds and had the censor investigate.

sentences.zh: 延壽聞知，即部吏案校望之在馮翊時廩犧官錢放散百餘萬。

translations.literal: Yannian heard of it and at once had his clerks investigate and verify that while Wangzhi was in Feng more than a million in granary and sacrificial official funds had been dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian heard of it and at once had his clerks investigate and verify that while Wangzhi was in Feng more than a million in granary and sacrificial official funds had been dispersed.

sentences.zh: 望之自奏：「職在總領天下，聞事不敢不問，而為延壽所拘持。

translations.literal: Wangzhi himself memorialized: "My duty is to oversee all under Heaven; hearing of matters I dare not fail to inquire—yet I am seized and held by Yannian.
translations.idiomatic: Wangzhi himself memorialized: "My duty is to oversee all under Heaven; hearing of matters I dare not fail to inquire—yet I am seized and held by Yannian.

sentences.zh: 」上由是不直延壽，各令窮竟所考。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon did not side with Yannian and ordered each to pursue to the end what was investigated.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon did not side with Yannian and ordered each to pursue to the end what was investigated.

sentences.zh: 望之卒無事實。

translations.literal: Wangzhi in the end had no substantiated matter.
translations.idiomatic: Wangzhi in the end had no substantiated matter.

sentences.zh: 而望之遣御史案東郡者，得其試騎士日奢僭逾制；

translations.literal: But the censor Wangzhi had sent to investigate Dong commandery found that on days of cavalry trials he was extravagant and transgressed regulations;
translations.idiomatic: But the censor Wangzhi had sent to investigate Dong commandery found that on days of cavalry trials he was extravagant and transgressed regulations;

sentences.zh: 又取官銅物，候月食鑄刀劍，效尚方事；

translations.literal: moreover he took official copper goods and, watching for lunar eclipses, cast swords and blades, imitating the Imperial Workshop;
translations.idiomatic: moreover he took official copper goods and, watching for lunar eclipses, cast swords and blades, imitating the Imperial Workshop;

sentences.zh: 及取官錢帛私假徭使吏；

translations.literal: and took official money and silks to lend privately for corvée labor and employ clerks;
translations.idiomatic: and took official money and silks to lend privately for corvée labor and employ clerks;

sentences.zh: 及治飾車甲三百萬以上。

translations.literal: and in repairing and adorning chariots and armor spent more than three million.
translations.idiomatic: and in repairing and adorning chariots and armor spent more than three million.

sentences.zh: 延壽竟坐狡猾不道，棄市。

translations.literal: Yannian in the end was convicted of cunning impiety and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian in the end was convicted of cunning impiety and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 吏民數千人送至渭城，老小扶持車轂，爭奏酒炙。

translations.literal: Several thousand officials and commoners escorted him to Weicheng; old and young supported his carriage hubs and vied to present wine and roasted meat.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand officials and commoners escorted him to Weicheng; old and young supported his carriage hubs and vied to present wine and roasted meat.

sentences.zh: 延壽不忍距逆，人人為飲，計飲酒石餘。

translations.literal: Yannian could not bear to refuse them; each man he made drink, and the wine consumed amounted to more than a shi.
translations.idiomatic: Yannian could not bear to refuse them; each man he made drink, and the wine consumed amounted to more than a shi.

sentences.zh: 使掾、史分謝送者：「遠苦吏民，延壽死無所恨！

translations.literal: He had his clerks and secretaries thank the escorts in turn: "You have come far and troubled officials and people—Yannian dies without regret!
translations.idiomatic: He had his clerks and secretaries thank the escorts in turn: "You have come far and troubled officials and people—Yannian dies without regret!

sentences.zh: 」百姓莫不流涕。

translations.literal: " The common people none failed to shed tears.
translations.idiomatic: " The common people none failed to shed tears.

sentences.zh: 1春，正月，上幸甘泉，郊泰畤。

translations.literal: 1. In spring, the first month, the emperor favored Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the border to the Great Altar.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In spring, the first month, the emperor traveled to Sweet Springs and sacrificed at the Great Altar.

sentences.zh: ----2車騎將軍韓增薨。

translations.literal: ----2 General of Chariots and Cavalry Han Zeng died.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 General of Chariots and Cavalry Han Zeng died.

sentences.zh: 五月，將軍許延壽為大司馬、車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, General Xu Yannian became Grand Marshal and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, General Xu Yannian became Grand Marshal and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: ----3丞相丙吉年老，上重之。

translations.literal: ----3 Chancellor Bing Ji was old in years; the emperor greatly esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 Chancellor Bing Ji was old in years; the emperor greatly esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 蕭望之意常輕吉，上由是不悅。

translations.literal: Xiao Wangzhi's mind often looked lightly on Ji; the emperor was thereby displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Wangzhi often looked lightly on Ji; the emperor was thereby displeased.

sentences.zh: 丞相司直奏望之遇丞相禮節倨慢，又使吏買賣，私所附益凡十萬三千，請逮捕系治。

translations.literal: The Chancellor's Direct Investigator memorialized that in meeting the chancellor Wangzhi's ritual and deportment were arrogant and slow, and that he also had clerks buy and sell, with private additions totaling one hundred three thousand, requesting arrest and imprisonment for trial.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor's Direct Investigator memorialized that in meeting the chancellor Wangzhi's ritual and deportment were arrogant and slow, and that he also had clerks buy and sell, with private additions totaling one hundred three thousand, requesting arrest and imprisonment for trial.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，壬午，詔左遷望之為太子太傅；

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day renwu, an edict demoted Wangzhi to Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the eighth month, on the day renwu, an edict demoted Wangzhi to Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent;

sentences.zh: 以太子太傅黃霸為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent Huang Ba was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent Huang Ba was made Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: ----4匈奴呼韓邪單于遣其弟右谷蠡王等西襲屠耆單于屯兵，殺略萬餘人。

translations.literal: ----4 The Xiongnu chanyu Huhanye sent his younger brother the Right Guli King and others west to strike the garrison troops of Chanyu Tujue, killing and carrying off more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 The Xiongnu chanyu Huhanye sent his younger brother the Right Guli King and others west to strike the garrison troops of Chanyu Tujue, killing and carrying off more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于聞之，即自將六萬騎擊呼韓邪單于。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue heard of it and at once himself led sixty thousand horse to strike Chanyu Huhanye.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue heard of it and at once himself led sixty thousand horse to strike Chanyu Huhanye.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于兵敗，自殺。

translations.literal: Chanyu Tujue's army was defeated and he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tujue's army was defeated and he killed himself.

sentences.zh: 都隆奇乃與屠耆少子右谷蠡王姑瞀樓頭亡歸漢。

translations.literal: Dulongqi thereupon fled with Tujue's younger son the Right Guli King Gumoloutou and returned to Han.
translations.idiomatic: Dulongqi thereupon fled with Tujue's younger son the Right Guli King Gumoloutou and returned to Han.

sentences.zh: 車犁單于東降呼韓邪單于。

translations.literal: Chanyu Chelí submitted in the east to Chanyu Huhanye.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Chelí submitted in the east to Chanyu Huhanye.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，呼韓邪單于左大將烏厲屈與父呼遫累烏厲溫敦皆見匈奴亂，率其眾數萬人降漢；

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, Chanyu Huhanye's Left Grand General Wuliju and his father Huzhilei Wuliwendun, both seeing the Xiongnu in disorder, led their multitudes of several tens of thousands to surrender to Han;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, Chanyu Huhanye's Left Grand General Wuliju and his father Huzhilei Wuliwendun, both seeing the Xiongnu in disorder, led their multitudes of several tens of thousands to surrender to Han;

sentences.zh: 封烏厲屈為新城侯，烏厲溫敦為義陽侯。

translations.literal: Wuliju was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xincheng and Wuliwendun as Marquis of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuliju was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xincheng and Wuliwendun as Marquis of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 是時李陵子復立烏藉都尉為單于，呼韓邪單于捕斬之；

translations.literal: At this time Li Ling's son again installed the Wuji Colonel as Chanyu; Chanyu Huhanye captured and beheaded him;
translations.idiomatic: At this time Li Ling's son again installed the Wuji Colonel as Chanyu; Chanyu Huhanye captured and beheaded him;

sentences.zh: 遂復都單于庭，然眾裁數萬人。

translations.literal: he thereupon restored the capital at the Chanyu's court, yet his followers numbered only several tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon restored the Chanyu's court as capital, yet his followers numbered only several tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 屠耆單于從弟休旬王自立為閏振單于，在西邊；

translations.literal: Chanyu Tuji's younger brother by the female line, King Xiuxun, established himself as Chanyu Runzhen on the western border;
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Tuji's younger brother by the female line, King Xiuxun, established himself as Chanyu Runzhen in the west;

sentences.zh: 呼韓邪單于兄左賢王呼屠吾斯亦自立為郅支骨都侯單于，在東邊。

translations.literal: Chanyu Huhanye's elder brother, the Left Wise King Hutuwusi, also established himself as Chanyu Zhizhi Gudu-hou on the eastern border.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Huhanye's elder brother, the Left Wise King Hutuwusi, also established himself as Chanyu Zhizhi Gudu-hou in the east.

sentences.zh: ----5光祿勳平通侯楊惲，廉潔無私；

translations.literal: ----5 Director of the Gentlemen of the Palace, Marquis of Pingtong Yang Yun, was incorrupt and selfless;
translations.idiomatic: ----5 Director of the Gentlemen of the Palace, Marquis of Pingtong Yang Yun, was incorrupt and selfless;

sentences.zh: 然伐其行能，又性刻害，好發人陰伏，由是多怨於朝廷。

translations.literal: yet he vaunted his conduct and ability, and by nature was harsh and injurious, delighting in exposing people's hidden faults—thereby he incurred much resentment at court.
translations.idiomatic: yet he vaunted his conduct and ability, was by nature harsh and injurious, and delighted in exposing people's hidden faults—thereby incurring much resentment at court.

sentences.zh: 與太僕戴長樂相失。

translations.literal: He fell out with the Grand Coachman Dai Changle.
translations.idiomatic: He fell out with Grand Coachman Dai Changle.

sentences.zh: 人有上書告長樂罪，長樂疑惲教人告之，亦上書告惲罪曰：「惲上書訟韓延壽，郎中丘常謂惲曰：『聞君侯訟韓馮翊，當得活乎？

translations.literal: Someone submitted a memorial accusing Changle of crime; Changle suspected Yun had taught the man to accuse him and also submitted a memorial accusing Yun, saying: "Yun submitted a memorial suing Han Yanshou. Gentleman Qiu Chang said to Yun: 'I hear the Lord sued Governor of Han, Fengyi—will he live?
translations.idiomatic: Someone memorialized accusing Changle of crime; Changle suspected Yun had instigated it and also memorialized accusing Yun, saying, "Yun submitted a memorial suing Han Yanshou. Gentleman Qiu Chang said to Yun, 'I hear you sued Governor of Han, Fengyi—will he live?

sentences.zh: 』惲曰：『事何容易，脛脛者未必全也！

translations.literal: ' Yun said: 'How easy is the matter! One with skinny shins may not necessarily be preserved whole!
translations.idiomatic: ' Yun said, 'How easy is that! A man with skinny shins may not come through whole!

sentences.zh: 我不能自保，真人所謂「鼠不容穴，銜窶數」者也。

translations.literal: I cannot preserve myself—what the true man called "a mouse cannot tolerate a hole, holding poverty in its mouth."
translations.idiomatic: I cannot save myself—what the sage called 'a mouse cannot tolerate a hole, holding poverty in its mouth.'

sentences.zh: 』又語長樂曰：『正月以來，天陰不雨，此《春秋》所記，夏侯君所言。

translations.literal: ' He also said to Changle: 'Since the first month, the sky has been overcast without rain—this is what the Spring and Autumn records, what Lord Xiahou spoke of.
translations.idiomatic: ' He also told Changle, 'Since the first month the sky has been overcast without rain—this is what the Spring and Autumn records, what Lord Xiahou said.

sentences.zh: 』」事下廷尉。

translations.literal: '" The matter was sent down to the Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: '" The matter was sent to the Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 廷尉定國奏惲怨望，為妖惡言，大逆不道。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Dingguo memorialized that Yun harbored resentment, uttered evil and perverse words, and committed great impiety.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Dingguo reported that Yun harbored resentment, uttered evil and perverse words, and committed great impiety.

sentences.zh: 上不忍加誅，有詔皆免惲、長樂為庶人。

translations.literal: The emperor could not bear to add execution and issued an edict that both Yun and Changle be dismissed as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor could not bear to execute them and decreed that both Yun and Changle be dismissed as commoners.

sentences.zh: 1春，正月，癸卯，博陽定侯丙吉薨。

translations.literal: 1. Spring, first month, day guimao: Marquis Ding of Boyang Bing Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In spring, the first month, on day guimao, Marquis Ding of Boyang Bing Ji died.

sentences.zh: :班固贊曰：古之制名，必由象類，遠取諸物，近取諸身。

translations.literal: : Ban Gu's praise says: In antiquity naming was made necessarily from images and categories—taking from distant things, taking from the near body.
translations.idiomatic: : Ban Gu writes in praise: In antiquity names were fashioned from images and categories—drawing from distant things and from the body itself.

sentences.zh: 故《經》謂君為元首，臣為股肱，明其一體，相待而成也。

translations.literal: Therefore the Classic calls the ruler the head and limbs, ministers the thighs and arms—making clear they are one body, mutually relying to be completed.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Classic calls the ruler the head and limbs and ministers the thighs and arms—making clear they are one body that rely on each other to be whole.

sentences.zh: 是故君臣相配，古今常道，自然之勢也。

translations.literal: Therefore ruler and ministers match each other—the constant way of past and present, the natural tendency.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore ruler and ministers match each other—the constant way of past and present and the natural order.

sentences.zh: 近觀漢相，高祖開基，蕭、曹為冠；

translations.literal: Observing Han chancellors near at hand: Gaozu opened the foundation, Xiao and Cao were foremost;
translations.idiomatic: Observing Han chancellors at hand: Gaozu laid the foundation, and Xiao and Cao were foremost;

sentences.zh: 孝宣中興，丙、魏有聲。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiao's restoration, Bing and Wei had renown.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xuan's restoration, Bing and Wei won renown.

sentences.zh: 是時黜陟有序，眾職修理，公卿多稱其位，海內興於禮讓。

translations.literal: At that time promotion and demotion were orderly, the multitude of offices well maintained, ministers and grandees mostly filled their posts, and within the seas courtesy and yielding flourished.
translations.idiomatic: At that time promotion and demotion were orderly, offices well maintained, ministers and grandees mostly filled their posts, and courtesy and yielding flourished throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 覽其行事，豈虛虖哉！

translations.literal: Reviewing their conduct—was it empty indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Review their conduct—was it empty indeed!

sentences.zh: ----2二月，壬辰，黃霸為丞相。

translations.literal: ----2 Second month, day renchen: Huang Ba became chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In the second month, on day renchen, Huang Ba became chancellor.

sentences.zh: 霸材長於治民，及為丞相，功名損於治郡。

translations.literal: Ba's talent lay in governing the people; when he became chancellor, his fame and achievement fell short of governing a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Ba excelled at governing the people; as chancellor his fame and achievement fell short of his record as commandery governor.

sentences.zh: 時京兆尹張敞捨鶡雀飛集丞相府，霸以為神雀，議欲以聞。

translations.literal: At that time Metropolitan Governor Zhang Chang's lodging had a magpie fly and gather at the chancellor's residence; Ba took it for a divine bird and deliberated wishing to report it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Metropolitan Governor Zhang Chang had a magpie from his lodging fly to the chancellor's residence; Ba took it for a divine bird and considered reporting it.

sentences.zh: 敞奏霸曰：「竊見丞相請與中二千石、博士雜問郡、國上計長史、守丞為民興利除害，成大化，條其對。

translations.literal: Chang memorialized to Ba, saying: "Your servant has seen the chancellor request to join with ranked officials at two thousand shi and academicians in mixed questioning of the commandery and state annual-report chief clerks and administrators on benefiting the people and removing harm, accomplishing great transformation, and itemizing their replies.
translations.idiomatic: Chang memorialized to Ba, "Your servant has seen the chancellor request to join ranked officials at two thousand shi and academicians in questioning the commandery and state annual-report chief clerks and administrators on benefiting the people and removing harm, accomplishing great transformation, and itemizing their replies.

sentences.zh: 有耕者讓畔，男女異路，道不拾遺。

translations.literal: There were farmers yielding field boundaries, men and women on separate roads, and no picking up lost things on the road.
translations.idiomatic: There were farmers yielding field boundaries, men and women on separate roads, and no picking up lost things on the road.

sentences.zh: 及舉孝子、貞婦者為一輩，先上殿；

translations.literal: Those who presented filial sons and chaste wives formed one class and entered the hall first;
translations.idiomatic: Those who presented filial sons and chaste wives formed one class and entered the hall first;

sentences.zh: 舉而不知其人數者，次之；

translations.literal: those who presented them without knowing the persons' names came next;
translations.idiomatic: those who presented them without knowing the persons' names came next;

sentences.zh: 不為條教者在後。

translations.literal: those who did not make regulations and teachings came last.
translations.idiomatic: those who did not make regulations and teachings came last.

sentences.zh: 叩頭謝丞相，雖口不言，而心欲其為之也。

translations.literal: They kowtowed and thanked the chancellor; though the mouth did not speak, the heart wished them to do it.
translations.idiomatic: They kowtowed and thanked the chancellor; though they did not speak aloud, they wished in their hearts to do it.

sentences.zh: 長史、守丞對時，臣敞舍有鶡雀飛止丞相府屋上，丞相以下見者數百人。

translations.literal: When the chief clerks and administrators replied, your servant Chang's lodging had a magpie fly and perch on the chancellor's residence roof; from the chancellor down, those who saw it numbered several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: When the chief clerks and administrators replied, a magpie from your servant Chang's lodging flew and perched on the chancellor's roof; from the chancellor down, several hundred people saw it.

sentences.zh: 邊吏多知鶡雀者，問之，皆陽不知。

translations.literal: Many frontier officials knew magpies; when asked, all pretended not to know.
translations.idiomatic: Many frontier officials knew magpies; when asked, all pretended ignorance.

sentences.zh: 丞相圖議上奏曰：『臣問上計長史、守丞以興化條，皇天報下神爵。

translations.literal: The chancellor drafted deliberation to memorialize upward, saying: 'Your servant questioned the annual-report chief clerks and administrators on items for promoting transformation—August Heaven responded by sending down the divine bird.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor drafted a memorial saying, 'Your servant questioned the annual-report chief clerks and administrators on items for promoting transformation—August Heaven responded by sending down the divine bird.

sentences.zh: 』後知從臣敞舍來，乃止。

translations.literal: ' Later learning it came from your servant Chang's lodging, he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: ' Learning later it came from your servant Chang's lodging, he stopped.

sentences.zh: 郡國吏竊笑丞相仁厚有知略，微信奇怪也。

translations.literal: Commandery and state officials privately laughed that the chancellor, though benevolent and thick and possessed of knowledge and strategy, still slightly believed in the strange.
